desc: Test matrix B3 (l3-011): a guest already in the host's room (the plaza) opens its Start menu and joins from it, the host playing as Bowser. With no room change the menu used to stay up for good: the guest's next Start opened the co-op player menu over it, and its game stayed paused (system level 15, field battles off: fbat mode 7). Now the join closes the menu by itself through its own close ("Joining Test Host's game..."), the guest's screen is live, nothing is paused (level 0 in where coop) and the player menu never opens over a Start menu
